title: HR Export uses the identical authoritative continuous carry-in as Staff/Admin OT detail
changes: Fix: V318 Excel Export previously called a private legacy carry-in function; the live UI uses public V368 cumulative carry-in. Both Excel Export and dummy-date preview now call the same V368 public carry-in formula.
Fetch current authoritative carry-in with force refresh just before preview/export, and stop export if ledger is missing or invalid (no silent legacy fallback).
Show per-staff live opening carry, source month, current HR-equivalent OT, claimed hours and money in the special-day preview before committing Export.
Preserve current OT hour calculations, 8-hour claim blocks, base rate rules, staff allocations, HR snapshots, adjustment history and database contents.
Re-export of October 2026 requires the safe reopen and reconciliation workflow; an uploaded patch will not change old Excel or old exported snapshot.
review_note: Live Supabase verification required before payroll use; mismatches caused by differing eligible OT source rows may remain until reconciled.
